title: Suppress already-running launch preflight alert
summary: Suppress the topbar Launch startup alert when backend preflight is blocked only because pipeline work is already active.
reason: The active-work guard is safety-critical for duplicate start prevention, but surfacing it as a large startup blocker is noisy and misleading when the operator intentionally opens the app while work is already running.
behavior_before: Any blocked pipeline backend-preflight row, including active_work, created the large Launch startup alert.
behavior_after: active_work and process_launch_lock rows remain visible in backend preflight evidence but do not create the startup alert; other blocked pipeline rows still alert.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_launch_command_buttons_smoke -q - failed unrelated existing expectation for launch-readiness-actions markup removed in dirty worktree
rollback_plan: Revert the launchView.preflight.js startup-alert filter and the matching WebView smoke expectation.
notes:
Suppress startup alert for active-work/already-running preflight rows while retaining serious blocker alerts.
Cover suppressed active-work startup alert and preserved serious backend preflight alert.
Refresh generated summaries for touched WebView preflight asset and smoke test.
